description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 
Job Description 
 About Our Team: 
Our team builds and supports innovative software solutions that improve engineering productivity and enable intelligent business workflows. We harness modern full stack technologies, cloud-native platforms, and AI-powered approaches to development in order to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable applications that support critical business operations! 

 Position Overview: 
We are seeking an AI Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and support modern applications that incorporate AI as a core capability. This role combines full stack software engineering with AI-native development practices, including custom agent development, prompt engineering, MCP integrations, and AI-assisted software delivery to improve development efficiency and business outcomes. 

 Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and support full stack applications, owning features throughout the entire software development lifecycle. 
 Build and implement personalized AI assistants that automate workflows, support decision-making, enable summarization, and implement multi-step business processes. 
 Develop integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar frameworks to enable interoperability between AI models, tools, and systems. 
 Integrate applications with AI services such as LLMs, embeddings, search platforms, and RAG solutions while ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and performance. 
 Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and refactoring while maintaining engineering standards and code quality. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field and 5+ years of software engineering experience. 
 3+ years of experience developing and supporting production-grade full stack or backend applications using C#, ASP.NET, Angular, REST APIs, and relational or NoSQL databases. 
 2+ years of experience working with cloud-native technologies, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and Kubernetes-based deployment environments. 
 1+ year of hands-on experience designing and implementing AI-enabled solutions, including custom AI agents, prompt engineering, RAG systems, or LLM integrations. 
 Demonstrated experience designing scalable software architectures and owning applications through design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operational support. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 2+ years of experience applying AI-assisted development practices to improve software engineering productivity and reduce development cycles. 
 Experience designing and implementing custom AI agents using MCP or similar structured agent and tool orchestration frameworks. 
 Demonstrated success deploying AI-enabled applications in mission-critical or high-availability environments with stringent reliability requirements. 
 Experience evaluating, refining, and operationalizing AI-generated code and outputs for production use. 
 Experience building interoperable AI ecosystems that integrate multiple models, tools, APIs, and data sources without tightly coupled architectres. 
 
 
 As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . 
 
 Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
 
 To learn about your right to work click here. 
 
 To learn more about Micron, please visit micron.com/careers 
 
 For US Sites Only: To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact Micron’s People Organization at  hrsupport_na@micron.com or 1-800-336-8918 (select option #3)
 
 Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.
 
 Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.
 
 AI alert : Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.   
 
 Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.
